evals.prompt: Build me a lead list from this audience targeting doc: evals/files/test-audience-targeting.md
evals.expected_output: Two API queries built (one per segment) with correct filters, presented for user validation before any API calls
expectations: First output is the built query JSON, not API results
Two separate queries were built (one for Gyms, one for Med Spas)
Industries filter uses valid values from industries.json (e.g., 'wellness and fitness services' for gyms, 'medical practices' for med spas)
Location includes 'United States' and excludes 'Nevada' and 'Arizona'
Seniority includes 'Owner' and 'Founder' but NOT 'CXO' or 'President'
Does NOT use contact.title include filter (it is broken)
Does NOT use contact.department or contact.skills filters (they are broken)
Company type includes 'PRIVATELY_HELD' and 'SELF_OWNED'
Segment A employee size range is 1-50
Segment B employee size range is 1-25
Founded year range ends at 2023 or earlier
API credits were checked before building queries
User was asked to validate before any API call was made
A filter summary table was shown for each segment

evals.prompt: I need to pull a lead list for the gym and med spa targeting. The doc is at evals/files/test-audience-targeting.md
evals.expected_output: Skill triggered, audience doc parsed, both segments identified with filter summary and JSON queries presented
expectations: Skill was triggered (recognized lead list building intent)
Audience targeting document was read and parsed correctly
Both segments were identified and separated (Gyms and Med Spas)
Filter summary table was shown for each segment
Full JSON query was presented for each segment in a code block
No API calls were made before user approval
Keyword source 'KEYWORD' was not used (it is broken)
industries.json was read to validate industry names

evals.prompt: Build a lead list from evals/files/test-audience-targeting.md. Make sure to use keyword filters for 'CrossFit' and 'boutique fitness' in addition to all the other filters.
evals.expected_output: Queries built with keyword filters using DESCRIPTION+INDUSTRY sources, with a warning about filter stacking
expectations: Keyword filter was included with content 'CrossFit' and 'boutique fitness'
Keyword sources include 'DESCRIPTION' and/or 'INDUSTRY' but never 'KEYWORD'
A warning was shown about filter stacking (many filters may return 0 results)
Skill suggested starting with broader filters first
Query was still built as requested despite the warning
User was asked to validate before any API execution
Seniority does NOT include 'CXO' or 'President'
